IEM Rio 2024 for Counter-Strike 2 is scheduled to take place over October 7-13, 2024. You can find more information about the tournament here: https://pro.eslgaming.com/tour/cs/rio/

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Complexity wins this tournament. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If this team is eliminated from the competition based on the official rules of the tournament, this market will resolve to “No”.

If the winner of IEM Rio 2024 is not determined by October 27, 2024 ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information provided directly from ESL (e.g. pro.eslgaming.com) and official footage of the tournament, however other credible reporting may be used.

body.title: CS: 3DMAX vs FaZe
body.description:
This market will resolve to “3DMAX” if 3DMAX win against FaZe in the named Counter-Strike match.

This market will resolve to “FaZe” if FaZe win against 3DMAX in the Counter-Strike match.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.

If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from liquipedia: https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/Main_Page
